Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking time to speak with us last week. Per our conversation, I put together a 60-minute walkthrough so we can cover architecture, latency/cost expectations, and an implementation plan for the pilot.

Proposed time: Friday, Jun 9 at 3:00 PM PT (60 minutes)
Quick agenda:
- 3:00–3:10: intros and success criteria
- 3:10–3:30: product walkthrough (hosted + private deployment options)
- 3:30–3:50: technical deep-dive (SE)
- 3:50–4:00: next steps / mutual action plan

Attaching the one-pager and deck we referenced: NimbusIntro_v2.pdf.

If that slot doesn’t work, let me know two alternative windows and I’ll coordinate. Marissa and Karthik are cc’d to block SE coverage.

Best,
Logan Wright

logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Thanks Logan —

Quick heads up: we just pushed a mandatory exec all-hands at 3pm on Friday that a subset of our stakeholders must attend. We still want the session but can't do the full 60 minutes at that time.

Two options from our side:
1) Keep Friday 3pm and compress to 30 minutes (high-level only)
2) Move to Tue Jun 13 or Wed Jun 14 next week (we have more availability)

If you can do a 30-minute version on Friday, that would help — otherwise Tuesday 11am PT works for us.

Appreciate the flexibility,
Aisha

Logan —

I am actually on travel that day: landing midday and I won’t have a reliable laptop connection until late evening. I can’t commit to a 20-minute live technical segment at 3pm PT.

Options I can support:
- Move the session to Tue Jun 13 11:00 AM PT — I can be fully there for a 45–60 minute run.
- If the team needs something before then, I will record a 7–10 minute technical snippet covering deployment options, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and recommended batch/cache settings for their expected workload. I can attach SE-Notes.docx with talking points. I can also plan to dial in on my phone for the final 10–15 minutes of the Friday 30m if connectivity allows (no guarantees).

I attached the SE notes for internal reference. If Logan wants to run the 30m with a compressed agenda, keep it strictly: 10m product + 15m technical Q/A. I’ll make the recording ASAP today so you can send it to Aisha before the meeting.

Thanks —
